title: Grilled Middle Eastern Turkey Skewers
description: Juicy turkey skewers marinated in zesty Egyptian spices and grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of your favorite salad or roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: Turkey breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: You can also use thighs if preferred

ingredients.name: Zesty Egyptian spice blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of paprika, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper

ingredients.name: Neck of celery, cut into 1-inch pieces
Wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak them in water for 30 minutes before grilling

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (400°F/200°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the zesty Egyptian spice blend, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the turkey cubes and celery pieces to the marinade. Toss to coat.
Thread the turkey and celery onto the wooden skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the turkey is cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
